## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] Docs updated (package README / root README / DESIGN.md) if behavior changed
- [ ] No new runtime dependency, or it's justified in the PR description
- [ ] Stays **local-first**: no new network calls, telemetry, or required cloud
- [ ] Stays **private by default**: no new data recorded without a clear opt-in
